goal: Prevent outbound transports from aborting or writing out of bounds on oversized message types
Drop or assert on outbound messages that exceed the 4 MB limit before queueing them
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (ajtowns, naiyoma)
Objection that returning false would stall connections was resolved by moving checks (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents memory corruption and process aborts in outbound P2P transports
Eliminates transport-layer buffer overruns and payload overwrites from oversized messages
